boundary: A bounded lazy-cut search must NOT be relabeled as infeasibility. Full certified UNSAT would require reproducible solver settings and independent proof checks.
positive_control: A full candidate requires 0, infinity, I, S2 plus 4 candidates; every pair sum nonsingular and all nonsingular extenders blocked

results.modeling: Exact 2336 covering clauses plus lazily added VALID pairwise-compatibility no-good cuts
results.proof_boundary: No absence proof for UNKNOWN or non-compatible feasible examples; if both S3 representatives return PROVED_INFEASIBLE and no valid witness exists, a size-eight no-go would follow subject to an independently checkable SAT proof, which CP-SAT does not export here.
